items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: Only boys I know named Love played trumpet. They were from Texas.

ctx.x: that's right there on there. Yeah, and he played with Willie Jackson, and did they have anybody else?

No, just the two. Not Charlie Love on trumpet? No. No. Only boys I know named Love played trumpet. They were from Texas. Charlie Love? Yeah, he was from Texas. Yeah. And it was one of the Loves played on the boat there with Faith, with Faith Marvel. A trumpet player? Yeah, a trumpet player. He was from either Houston or Dallas, or one.

Yeah. Yeah. Charlie Love. Yeah. He was a good trumpet player. Yeah. He could play ractime and all those tricky stuff. Yeah. And Willie Jackson used to sing. What did he sing, Willie Jackson? Blues. And? Mostly blues, popular songs, and things like that. And this was in 19... 1918, 1919. Oh yeah, that early. Yeah, way back there. Yeah. Willie Jackson made some records in New Orleans. Yeah. I don't know which one it was, but he made them. Yeah. Yeah. I was there when Bessie Smith come there the first time. At the…
